title: HTMCs 3D Culture Method Using Corning Matrigel Matrix
author: Stefania Vernazza
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.574g9qw
materials: Human trabecular meshwork cells (HTMC) and their Growth Medium with FBS, theTrabecular Meshwork Growth Medium (TMGM), from Cell APPLICATION INC. Maintain the HTMCs at 37◦C in a humidified atmosphere containing 5% CO 2 , according to the manufacturer’s indications. Sub-cultured HTMCs by TripLE TM Express (Invitrogen Life Technologies) treatment when the original flask is approximately 75% confluent.

steps.title: Embed cells in cold Matrigel
steps.instruction: Centrifuge HTMCs at 90 rcf for 5 min, discard supernatant, and gently resuspend the pellet in undiluted Matrigel™ kept on ice (4 °C). Calculate Matrigel volume using the formula Volume (ml) / culture chamber area (cm²); for example, 0.2 ml Matrigel over a chamber with area [(1.77/2) × 2 × π] cm² yields a thickness of ~1.13 mm. Pipette the cell‑Matrigel mixture into the culture chambers.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge cells at 90 rcf for 5 min.
Resuspend pellet in undiluted Matrigel at 4 °C.
Calculate required Matrigel volume per chamber (e.g., 0.2 ml for the given area).
Transfer the embedded cells into culture chambers with a pipette.

steps.title: Gel Matrigel and add medium
steps.instruction: Allow the Matrigel to solidify for 15 min at room temperature, then add the appropriate culture medium and incubate the chambers under standard culture conditions.

substeps.instruction: Wait 15 min for Matrigel to gel.
Add culture medium to each chamber.

steps.title: Serum‑free pre‑culture
steps.instruction: Maintain the 3D HTMC cultures for at least 24 h in a 1:1 mixture of low‑glucose and high‑glucose DMEM supplemented with 2 mM L‑glutamine, 0.5 % gentamicin, and 100 µg ml⁻¹ streptomycin, without fetal bovine serum.

steps.title: Perform experimental treatments
steps.instruction: Carry out the planned experimental conditions on the pre‑conditioned 3D cultures.

steps.title: Recover cells from Matrigel
steps.instruction: At the end of the treatments, release the 3D‑HTMCs using Corning® Cell Recovery Solution, following Corning’s “RECOVERY OF CELLS FROM CORNING MATRIGEL MATRIX” protocol.

steps.title: Process recovered cells
steps.instruction: Proceed with downstream molecular analyses on the recovered cell samples.
